svg.desc: 9 resources (6 spatial cards, 3 logical resources in 3 group cards) · 11 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified.

Hollow circles mark resource/card attachment points; neither end of an undirected line is a directional start.

not express direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
